title: Payload: map measurement v1
description: A distance or path measured with a map measurement tool. The measured line is the envelope geometry (a LineString, 3D when heights were measured). Edits to the measurement are new records with revision_of.

edit_sequence.description: Increments each time the operator edits the measurement

measurement_type.description: DISTANCE = two points; PATH = length along three or more points

method.description: How lengths were computed on the WGS-84 ellipsoid; SLANT_3D includes height differences

segment_lengths_m.description: One length per segment, in geometry order

initial_bearing_deg.description: Bearing of the first segment at its start point

references.description: Entities the measurement was taken to or from, e.g. a track or zone
